name: studyplanrevision
sql:
CREATE TABLE studyplanrevision (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	curriculum_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	local_date VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	timezone VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	target_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	settings_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	policy_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_plan_revision UNIQUE (curriculum_id, local_date, timezone, revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(curriculum_id) REFERENCES curriculum (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_active_study_plan ON studyplanrevision (curriculum_id, local_date, timezone) WHERE active=1

name: studyplanentry
sql:
CREATE TABLE studyplanentry (
	plan_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	item_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	activity_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (plan_id, item_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_plan_activity UNIQUE (plan_id, activity_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(plan_id) REFERENCES studyplanrevision (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES dailyplanitem (id)
)

name: timedtestsession
sql:
CREATE TABLE timedtestsession (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	curriculum_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	blueprint_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	deadline_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	report_json VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(curriculum_id) REFERENCES curriculum (id)
)

name: timedtestitem
sql:
CREATE TABLE timedtestitem (
	session_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	selection_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	weight FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	negative_mark FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	draft_json VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (session_id, position), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES timedtestsession (id), 
	UNIQUE (selection_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(selection_id) REFERENCES assessmentselection (id)
)
